{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
n_total = len(treatment_only)
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print the exact numbers as computed
print(n_total)
print(n_responded)
print(fraction_responded)"}
